blurb: Guests can rent luxury tri-toon pontoons and party barges for half or full day outings on the lake. The marina offers over 500 wet slips for boats up to 60 feet, including covered and uncovered options and dedicated jet ski slips. Amenities include a fuel dock, ship's store, and waterfront dining with private event space.
extraNote: Cancel 48+ hours prior to arrival for full refund · Weather cancellations by the marina are fully refunded · Security deposit required at time of rental · Fuel cost not included; boats depart full and renter responsible for refueling · Year-round
